SELECT g.id, g.destination_id, g.author_id, g.title, g.summary, g.cover_image_url, g.location_text, g.scope, g.travel_mode, g.published_at, g.days, g.budget_total, g.views_count, g.likes_count, g.comments_count, g.favorites_count, g.status, d.name AS destination_name, up.nickname AS author_name, up.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url FROM guides g LEFT JOIN destinations d ON d.id = g.destination_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = g.author_id
ORDER BY g.likes_count DESC, g.views_count DESC, g.id DESC
ORDER BY g.published_at DESC, g.id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT g.id, g.destination_id, g.author_id, g.title, g.summary, g.cover_image_url, g.location_text, g.scope, g.travel_mode, g.published_at, g.days, g.budget_total, g.views_count, g.likes_count, g.comments_count, g.favorites_count, g.status, d.name AS destination_name, up.nickname AS author_name, up.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url FROM guides g LEFT JOIN destinations d ON d.id = g.destination_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = g.author_id WHERE g.publish_status = 'published' AND g.destination_id = #{destinationId} ORDER BY g.published_at DESC, g.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM guides WHERE publish_status = 'published' AND destination_id = #{destinationId}

SELECT g.id, g.destination_id, g.author_id, g.title, g.summary, g.content_html, g.cover_image_url, g.location_text, g.scope, g.travel_mode, g.published_at, g.days, g.budget_total, g.views_count, g.likes_count, g.comments_count, g.favorites_count, g.status, d.name AS destination_name, up.nickname AS author_name, up.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url FROM guides g LEFT JOIN destinations d ON d.id = g.destination_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = g.author_id WHERE g.id = #{guideId} AND g.publish_status = 'published'
SELECT id, guide_id, day_no, title, summary, sort_order FROM guide_itinerary_days WHERE guide_id = #{guideId} ORDER BY day_no ASC

SELECT g.id, g.destination_id, g.author_id, g.title, g.summary, g.cover_image_url, g.location_text, g.scope, g.travel_mode, g.published_at, g.days, g.budget_total, g.views_count, g.likes_count, g.comments_count, g.favorites_count, g.status, d.name AS destination_name, up.nickname AS author_name, up.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url FROM guides g LEFT JOIN destinations d ON d.id = g.destination_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = g.author_id WHERE g.publish_status = 'published' ORDER BY g.likes_count DESC, g.views_count DESC, g.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT g.id, g.destination_id, g.author_id, g.title, g.summary, g.cover_image_url, g.location_text, g.scope, g.travel_mode, g.published_at, g.days, g.budget_total, g.views_count, g.likes_count, g.comments_count, g.favorites_count, g.status, d.name AS destination_name, up.nickname AS author_name, up.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url FROM guides g LEFT JOIN destinations d ON d.id = g.destination_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = g.author_id WHERE g.publish_status = 'published' ORDER BY g.likes_count DESC, g.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT g.id, g.destination_id, g.author_id, g.title, g.summary, g.cover_image_url, g.location_text, g.scope, g.travel_mode, g.published_at, g.days, g.budget_total, g.views_count, g.likes_count, g.comments_count, g.favorites_count, g.status, d.name AS destination_name, up.nickname AS author_name, up.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url FROM guides g LEFT JOIN destinations d ON d.id = g.destination_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = g.author_id WHERE g.publish_status = 'published' AND (g.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR g.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR g.content_html LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) ORDER BY g.likes_count DESC, g.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT g.id, g.destination_id, g.author_id, g.title, g.summary, g.cover_image_url, g.location_text, g.scope, g.travel_mode, g.published_at, g.days, g.budget_total, g.views_count, g.likes_count, g.comments_count, g.favorites_count, g.status, d.name AS destination_name, up.nickname AS author_name, up.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url FROM guides g LEFT JOIN destinations d ON d.id = g.destination_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = g.author_id WHERE g.id = #{id}

SELECT g.id, g.destination_id, g.author_id, g.title, g.summary, g.cover_image_url, g.location_text, g.scope, g.travel_mode, g.published_at, g.days, g.budget_total, g.views_count, g.likes_count, g.comments_count, g.favorites_count, g.status, d.name AS destination_name, up.nickname AS author_name, up.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url FROM guides g LEFT JOIN destinations d ON d.id = g.destination_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = g.author_id WHERE g.author_id = #{authorId} ORDER BY g.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
